items.title: Keter Betts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: The P & R man was Bobby Shad.

ctx.x: The recording scene in New York was pretty active, right?
Oh, yeah. Very much so. Very much. Dinah was with Emarcy, which was subsidiary of Mercury. The P & R man was Bobby Shad.
You worked with one of my favorite people of all time, Cannonball Adderley.
